data.title: Nene Royal: Global Stardom Won’t Change Me, Says AGT Winner at Bangkok Homecoming
data.description: The 16-year-old America's Got Talent champion on her whirlwind rise, her proud family and what comes next after a hero's welcome in Bangkok

data.title: Flooding in 27 provinces and Bangkok
data.description: Flooding continues to affect 27 provinces and Bangkok, impacting more than 1.17 million households nationwide, although water levels have begun receding in many areas, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: 40km pursuit ends Chinese man's escape to Malaysia
data.description: Three Thais were arrested after a 40-kilometre-long police pursuit while trying to smuggle an illegal Chinese migrant from Cambodian through Thailand to Malaysia.

data.title: Russia strikes hit Kyiv as Germany's Merz visits
data.description: KYIV - Russia struck a bridge in Kyiv on Sunday soon after Germany's chancellor arrived in Ukraine's capital on a surprise visit to demonstrate European support in the face of an upsurge in attacks.

data.title: Flood warnings for several areas
data.description: A flood warning has been issued for provinces facing the Chao Phraya River, as well as Phetchaburi, Chachoengsao and southern provinces, due to accumulated water and forecast rain.

data.title: Rare serow makes unusual appearance on Prachuap beach
data.description: PRACHUAP KHIRI KHAN - A wild serow, a rare and protected species, has been spotted roaming on a beach in Kui Buri district, an unusual sighting hailed by wildlife officials as a positive sign for the area’s ecosystem.

data.title: Sacked Thai Airways CEO denies allegations over wine procurement
data.description: Sacked Thai Airways International CEO Chai Eamsiri has strongly denied allegations of involvement in corruption and interfering in the airline’s wine procurement process.

data.title: Cry for help as French-Swiss lake dries up
data.description: LES BRENETS (SWITZERLAND) - The picturesque Lac des Brenets between France and Switzerland has dried up after a record-breaking hot summer, leaving locals crying out for help to save the lake.

data.title: Drainage slow, but no risk of fresh flooding, says governor
data.description: The flood is draining slowly in eastern Bangkok, but the good news is forecasts indicate there is no immediate risk of fresh flooding from rain or the runoff-surge coming from the North, Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Sunday.

data.title: Cornell president vows review in wake of alleged student gang rape
data.description: NEW YORK - The president of Cornell University voiced support Saturday for an external review of the institution facing widespread outcry over the alleged gang rape of a student in 2024.

data.title: Thai Buddhist art exhibition opens in South Korea featuring 55 items
data.description: The exhibition features 55 items from 13 national museums, tracing faith and artistic traditions while strengthening cultural ties between Thailand and South Korea.

data.title: US sailors can roam Phuket island during visit
data.description: Around 5,000 US navy sailors who arrived in Phuket on Sunday for a six-day rest and recreation visit can travel freely around the island during their stay.

data.title: US warships arrive in Phuket for 6-day visit
data.description: PHUKET - Two US Navy warships carrying more than 5,100 personnel anchored off Phuket on Sunday for a six-day port visit, with thousands of sailors heading ashore for rest and recreation leave.

data.title: 10 fans injured when car ploughs into NRL final crowd in Australia
data.description: SYDNEY -  A car crashed into a crowd of rugby league supporters in the eastern Australian city of Newcastle on Satureday, injuring ten people, three of them children, local officials said.

data.title: Asian Games closing ceremony to air as Thailand finishes with 18 golds
data.description: Thai fans can watch the closing ceremony live from 4pm on television and AIS PLAY, with sprinter Puripol Boonson receiving the men’s most valuable player award.

data.title: South Korean flag glitch sees Asian Games end on sour note
data.description: TOYOTA CITY, Japan - South Korea's Asian Games football captain called it "disappointing" after the country's flag appeared to get stuck during the victory ceremony following their win over hosts Japan.

data.title: Forum host Tuvalu at frontline of climate change
data.description: NADI, Fiji - When leaders visit the coral atolls that form the Pacific nation of Tuvalu on Tuesday, they will find a once-vibrant ecosystem wiped out due to climate change.

data.title: Brazil votes in nail-biter polls closely watched by Trump
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazilians vote Sunday in a toss-up race between President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro that will decide whether Latin America's biggest nation follows a regional swing to the right championed by US President Donald Trump.

data.title: Myanmar migrants sent back to war-torn nation from Malaysia
data.description: THANLYIN, Myanmar - Nearly 1,500 Myanmar migrants sent back from Malaysia arrived in their war-torn home country on Sunday, a Myanmar naval official said, returned under an opaque repatriation scheme.
